assumption: Selected Upstox Basic tariff observed 12 Nov 2026, applied to historical orders with dated NSE statutory rates. This is a counterfactual paper estimate, not proof of the account tariff on those dates. One recorded partial exit = one sell order. DP is allocated once per scrip/IST day among included sales. Missing archive rows can change entry and DP allocations. Rounding: half-up per component to paise. No cash, trade, return, risk or stored backtest is rewritten.

coverage.scope: 74 confirmed intraday closes from the preserved 11 November audit only; no open-holding reconstruction
